known_caveats: EXAM DATES ARE MOSTLY HISTORICAL: 239 historical vs 25 current-term (2026+). Only ~1 campus has a genuinely-future Exam-1 date. days_until_exam_1 is NOT reliable yet; use estimated windows (Exam 1 ~ term week 5-6).
MAP IS ESSENTIALLY EMPTY / STARTER-ONLY: 3 active campus_exams, 0 professor-specific maps, 0 approved topic mappings. Almost every professor currently receives the Global Starter Map.

PROPOSED != APPROVED: all 114 textbook_chapter_topic_mapping rows are state='proposed' with survive_topic_id=NULL. A human must attach the Survive unit and approve. Never render proposed as student-facing.
EXAM-RANGE FALSE POSITIVES: a few campus Exam-1 ranges are mis-parsed cumulative/final ranges (e.g. 1-24, 1-13). Filter/flag ranges whose span > ~6 chapters for review.
TEXTBOOK CONTAMINATION: a handful of textbook_reference rows are non-intro titles (Bookkeeping for Dummies, Canadian Income Taxation, Intermediate). Exclude on review.
SYLLABUS CLASSIFIER NOISE: some course_document rows typed 'syllabus' are actually handbooks/reports/listings/wrong-course. The ~234 'parsed syllabi' count is inflated by noise.
PROFESSOR ATTRIBUTION: professor_intro1_evidence links to campus_lead_suggestions via lead_suggestion_id when matched, else by name text — name matching is within-campus only and imperfect.
DARK CAMPUSES: ~435 campuses returned zero docs, overwhelmingly because no public domain is stored on the campus row (upstream data gap), not a discovery failure.
teaches_intro_1 boolean on campus_lead_suggestions is UNPOPULATED (0 rows) — do not rely on it; use professor_intro1_evidence (documents) and rmp_target_course_counts_json.intro_1.
